project_type: Turborepo monorepo: Fastify (TypeScript, ESM) modular-monolith API (apps/api) + Prisma/PostgreSQL (packages/db) + shared contracts (packages/shared) + Next.js web (apps/web, not touched by Phase 3)
build_system: npm workspaces + turbo. Root package.json defines turbo scripts. Per-workspace builds: @campusgate/shared (tsc), @campusgate/db (prisma generate), @campusgate/api (prisma generate + tsc). QUIRK: Prisma 8.0.0-rc update banner is NOISE — do NOT upgrade Prisma. Windows/PowerShell host.
test_framework: vitest in apps/api; `vitest run` (single run, never watch). apps/api/vitest.config.ts sets fileParallelism:false (serial file execution). Pure-logic unit tests + mocked-Prisma route-integration tests + real-DB integration via apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts.
build_command: From repo root: `npm ci`; `npm run build -w @campusgate/shared`; `npm run db:generate -w @campusgate/db`; `npm run build -w @campusgate/api`; `npm run build` (turbo build all).
test_command: `npm test -w @campusgate/api` (runs `vitest run`). Narrow a suite with `npm test -w @campusgate/api -- <substr>` (e.g. `-- timetable-conflict`, `-- catalogue-sync`, `-- tenant-escape`).
verification_instructions: Migration (packages/db, via DIRECT_URL/postgres): (1) hand-author migration.sql; (2) read-only `npx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --to-migrations prisma/migrations --exit-code` to confirm schema==migrations with no drift; (3) `npx prisma migrate deploy` to apply; (4) `npx prisma migrate status` must show 'up to date', the new dir applied, the 8 prior dirs untouched, NO ledger duplicates. NEVER `prisma migrate dev`, NEVER `prisma db push`, NEVER edit the 8 FROZEN migration dirs or the _prisma_migrations ledger. Then `npm run db:generate -w @campusgate/db`. Per-FEAT: run the narrow vitest suite(s) it adds. Final: full `npm test -w @campusgate/api` + full clean build. Transient `FATAL: tenant/user ... not found` = Supabase free-tier auto-pause → resume/retry, NOT a code fault.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma Client is generated (not checked in) via `npm run db:generate -w @campusgate/db` (also runs inside @campusgate/api build). No other generated/snapshot files. The migration.sql itself is hand-authored and checked in.
environment_constraints: Shared Supabase DB. Runtime = campass_app (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS) over txn pooler :6543 (DATABASE_URL, pgbouncer=true). Migrations/DDL + seed + escape adminClient = postgres over session pooler :5432 (DIRECT_URL). The session pooler caps ~15 clients (run teardown counts sequentially). vitest MUST stay fileParallelism:false. Only the tenant-escape suite hits the live DB among api tests besides the behavioral/academics/sis integration suites.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md at repo root (only node_modules/fastify/AGENTS.md — ignore). Governing docs under docs/: roadmap.md (THE spec), tenancy.md (§4 composite FKs, §5 RLS, §7 escape suite, §8 checklist), identity-rbac.md (§6 permission keys), superadmin-security.md (§6 audit), database.md (§4 migration rule, §6a frozen/ledger). Phase 3 is on main, no worktree, commit locally per FEAT, NEVER push. Every tenant-owned table needs institutionId + @@unique([id,institutionId]) + composite FKs incl. institutionId + ENABLE+FORCE RLS + the nullif-guarded policy pair + @@index([institutionId]) in the SAME migration.
key_patterns: Routes: single `authenticate` preHandler then per-route `requirePermission(key)` (NO requireModuleActive for foundational data — Phase 1/2 precedent); all I/O inside `withTenant(institutionId, tx => ...)` with institutionId from request.user (never body/param); every mutation writes `recordAuditEvent(input, tx)` (past-tense classes.* key) in the SAME tx; 404-on-out-of-scope for HOD. Pure services are DB-free and unit-tested without a DB (student-sis.ts / calendar-service.ts precedent). Migration SQL follows phase2_sis sections a-j. Append-only tables mirror student_profile_history (SELECT+INSERT RLS, NO modify policy, REVOKE UPDATE/DELETE, BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger raising restrict_violation). catalogue-sync.test.ts parses `INSERT INTO "permissions" ... ON CONFLICT` and `INSERT INTO "role_permissions" ... AS m(`; emit the FACULTY `roles` INSERT BEFORE the permissions block. workingDaysOfWeek coercion guard shape is in allowance-engine.ts (Array.isArray -> map(Number) -> filter 0..6 -> fallback [1..6]).
